title: Hopkins’ corner
html_source: Hopkins and Hopkins was a jeweler’s and watchmaker’s shop at the southern end of Lower Sackville (now O'Connell) Street.

 —Dedalus, you’re an antisocial being, wrapped up in yourself. I’m not. I’m a democrat and I’ll work and act for social liberty and equality among all classes
